metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC, Specificity, Sensitivity, PR-AUC

clinical_distinction_notes: Optic Disc Edema (blurred disc margins, neuro-ophthalmic disc swelling). Distinct from Drusen (DN). Published Table 3 reports 96 total positive cases across 3200 images.

Direct correspondence to hereditary pigmentary retinopathy presenting with peripheral bone-spicule pigmentation. CRITICAL LIMITATION: Severely inadequate sample size (N=10 across full 3200 cohort; lower in sub-partitions); point estimates are statistically fragile.
metric_eligibility: Exploratory Descriptive Analysis Only; Ineligible for standalone statistical validation claims

clinical_distinction_notes: RFMiD v1 annotates Myopic Atrophy (MYA) with 167 published positive cases. Internal source class includes broader high/pathological myopia fundus changes. Feature-level morphological evaluation only.
metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC (Conditional on MYA), Specificity

clinical_distinction_notes: RFMiD v1 annotates Optic Disc Cupping (ODC; 445 cases), which is a morphological sign, NOT a definitive diagnosis of Glaucoma. Physiological cupping without glaucoma exists, as does normal-tension glaucoma with subtle cupping. Cannot be treated as exact ground-truth glaucoma diagnosis.
metric_eligibility: Ranking Agreement, AUROC vs ODC; Ineligible for definitive clinical diagnostic specificity/F1
